lastResponse.text: I’m really glad you said that. What he said is a threat, and your safety comes first. If you feel in immediate danger right now, call nine one one: nine… one… one. If you want, I can connect you to two one one right now to help plan a safe Place for tonight without texts or messages. You can share very little, and we can keep this on voice only. Stay where other people are while we do this.
